caption: Bergkerk, Deventer
composition: Twin towers of tuff and brick with slate spires · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Bergkerk stands on the hill of the Bergkwartier. Each west tower has tuff Romanesque stages, a brick Gothic upper stage, and a slender slate spire. The church is closed. It is partly cloudy, about 12.2°C, with wind near 8.6 km/h and cloud cover about 73%. The Lebuinuskerk and the Waag are other places.
